title: Crypto Treasury Management: MultiversX and Ethereum
content_html:
You run a fund, a syndicate, or a DAO and your tokens sit in many wallets across different chains. You cannot see the total value, you cannot know which tokens are locked, and you cannot tell when the next distribution is due. Without a clear picture, you waste time gathering data, you risk missing deadlines, and you lose confidence from members.

Why visibility is the first step in crypto treasury management

Good treasury work starts with knowing exactly what you own. When every wallet is listed in a single place, you can add up the balances, compare them to your budget, and spot gaps. This level of clarity also helps you answer questions from investors, auditors, and community members quickly. It reduces manual spreadsheet work and cuts the chance of human error.

How to track MultiversX and Ethereum wallets in one dashboard

To bring together holdings from both MultiversX and Ethereum, follow these steps:

  • List every wallet address that your group uses. Include hardware wallets, software wallets, and any contract addresses that hold tokens.
  • Connect each address to a dashboard that reads on‑chain data. The dashboard should pull balances, token types, and transaction history without moving any funds.
  • Verify that the data matches what you see in each wallet’s native explorer. This double check ensures the dashboard is reading the chain correctly.
  • Set up alerts for large moves or for tokens that are about to unlock. Alerts keep you ahead of important events.

When you complete these steps, you can track MultiversX and Ethereum wallets in one dashboard and see the total exposure across both networks at a glance.

Reporting and vesting schedules made simple

Once you have all balances in one view, the next task is to turn that data into reports. A good reporting flow includes:

  • A snapshot of total holdings, broken down by chain and token.
  • A list of tokens that have vesting or unlock schedules, showing the amount that will become available each month.
  • A summary of upcoming distributions to members or investors, based on the vesting data.

These reports can be exported as CSV files or shared as read‑only links. They give your stakeholders the confidence that the treasury is being handled responsibly.

Benefits for funds, syndicates, and DAOs

  • Full picture: No more juggling multiple explorers or spreadsheets.
  • Non custodial safety: All data is read from the blockchain; funds never leave your wallets.
  • Time savings: Automated alerts and reports replace manual data pulls.
  • Transparency: Members can verify the numbers themselves, building trust.

If you need a tool that lets you track MultiversX and Ethereum wallets in one dashboard while keeping everything non custodial, you might want to check out cryptool.
